plan.title: SRC-PAR-016 — Bad phone number when inviting a vendor

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen used by the case.
Set the event type to RFQ before configuring the template and pricing sheet.
Provide the required event title for the create flow.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the product sheet is available.
Add the CYLINDER product and set the requested quantity as in the case.
Set the requested delivery location on the first product row.

args.goal: On the single-stage RFQ create screen, open the Participants or Invite Vendor flow, choose the option to add a new vendor, enter the phone number "12ab" in the phone field, and stop with the validation message "Please enter a valid phone number" visible.

steps.note: Perform the new-vendor invitation interaction that has no dedicated catalog step, including the invalid phone entry.

args.contains: Please enter a valid phone number

steps.note: Assert that Procol refused the malformed phone number with the required message.
